translation.en: A mother's kindness is great.
The student remembered the teacher's kindness.
The student succeeded thanks to his mother.
People of virtue are generous.
Prayer time is near.

translation.bs: Čovjek je čekao namaz u džamiji.
translation.en: The man waited for the prayer in the mosque.
The father went to the prayer.
The time of prayer is near.
The companions came to the house.
I visited the companions.
I sat with the companions.
The companions' house is large.
A person learns every day.
The doctor helped the person.
The student wrote about the human being.
The human mind is amazing.
The child is playing with the ball.
The mother carried the child.
The father went with the children.
The child's name is beautiful.
The child's name is beautiful.
The teacher forgot the student's name.

translation.bs: Učenici su se obradovali novim imenima.
translation.en: The students were glad about the new names.
The list of names is long.
The authority of the law is strong.
The judge has authority.

translation.bs: Svi su se pokorili vlasti zakona.
translation.en: Everyone submitted to the authority of the law.
The strength of authority is great.
The first time is difficult.

translation.bs: Djed se sjetio svog prvog puta u gradu.
translation.en: Grandfather remembered his first time in the city.
We traveled by train last time.

translation.bs: Sjećanja na prvi put u selu su lijepa.
translation.en: The memories of the first time in the village are beautiful.
Scheming is a bad characteristic.
The judge discovered the scheming.
The man escaped the scheming.
The danger of scheming is great.
Truthfulness is a beautiful character trait.
People love truthfulness.
The witness spoke with sincerity.
The proof of sincerity is clear.
Justice is the foundation of dominion.
The people loved the king's justice.
The workers demand justice.
Love of justice is human nature.
Charity helps the poor.
The merchant gave the charity to the poor man.
The poor man was glad about the charity.
The value of the charity is small.
The east is bright.
The writer visited the East.
The merchant traveled to the East.
The sky of the east is clear.
The hardship is severe for the poor man.
The poor man bears the hardship.

translation.bs: Otac je zaštitio svoju djecu od nevolje.
translation.en: The father protected his children from harm.
The pain of the hardship is severe.
The sick person slept early.
The doctor visited the sick person.

translation.bs: Medicinska sestra je sjedila s bolesnicima.
translation.en: The nurse sat with the sick people.
The room of the sick person is clean.
Error is dangerous.
The young man rejected error.

translation.bs: Učitelj je spasio učenika od zablude.
translation.en: The teacher saved the student from error.
The road of error is dark.
Crookedness appeared in the wall.
The worker repaired the crookedness.
The engineer looked at the crookedness.
The cause of the crookedness is known.
The will is in the drawer.
The lawyer read the will.

translation.bs: Djed je napisao svoje ime u oporuci.
translation.en: The grandfather wrote his name in the will.
The text of the will is clear.
Hunting is my father's hobby.
Grandfather loved hunting.
The father returned from hunting.
The hunting season began.
The room was cold.
The girl cleaned the room.
The child slept in the room.
The door of the room is open.
Greed spoils the heart.
The merchant rejected greed.
The man kept away from greed.
The danger of greed is great.
The mihrab was old.
The artist decorated the mihrab.
The imam stood in the mihrab.
The color of the mihrab is green.
The isthmus separates the two lakes.
The travelers crossed the isthmus.
The friends walked on the isthmus.
The length of the isthmus is short.
Humiliation is difficult for the soul.
The man rejected humiliation.
The people lived in humiliation.
The feeling of humiliation is painful.
The baggage was heavy.
The traveler carried the baggage.

translation.bs: Otac je stavio vodu u prtljag.
translation.en: The father put the water in the baggage.
The color of the baggage is black.
The dawn approached.
My grandfather waits for the dawn.
The farmer wakes up at dawn.
The breeze of the dawn is cold.
The chief of the tribe welcomed the guests.
The guest visited the chief of the village.

translation.bs: Muškarci su sjedili s poglavarom plemena.
translation.en: The men sat with the chief of the tribe.
The house of the chief of the tribe is large.
The rain fell on the fields.
The farmer waited for the rain.
The children rejoiced at the rain.
The sound of the rain is calm.
Sleep is important for children.
The cat loves sleep.
The doctor spoke about sleep.
The time of sleep is near.
The nose is a part of the face.
The child touched the cat's nose.
The doctor looked at the nose.
The form of the nose is small.
Nursing is beneficial for the child.
The mother began nursing.
The doctor advised nursing.

translation.bs: Majka je pitala o trajanju dojenja.
translation.en: The mother asked about the period of nursing.
The motion of the cars stopped.
The police officer observed the motion of the cars.

translation.bs: Naučnik je govorio o kretanju planeta.
translation.en: The scientist spoke about the motion of the planets.

translation.bs: Dijete je primijetilo sporost kretanja mrava.
translation.en: The child noticed the slowness of the ants' motion.
Divorce is difficult for the children.
The judge registered the divorce.
The lawyer spoke about the divorce.
The reason for the divorce is not clear.
